synth.name: Tuning Divisions Per Period
synth.description: Equal divisions of the period (12 = standard 12-TET, 19/22/31/53 etc. for microtonal EDOs). Ignored while a custom scale table is loaded.

synth.name: Tuning Period
synth.description: Size of the repeating period. 1200 = octave, 1901.955 = tritave (Bohlen-Pierce).

synth.name: Tuning Reference Note
synth.description: MIDI note number that sounds at the reference frequency.

synth.name: Tuning Reference Frequency
synth.description: Frequency of the reference note.

synth.name: Osc1 Waveform
synth.description: Waveform of oscillator 1.

synth.name: Osc1 Pulse Width
synth.description: Duty cycle of oscillator 1 when its waveform is Pulse (0.5 = square).

synth.name: Osc1 Level
synth.description: Mix level of oscillator 1.

synth.name: Osc2 Waveform
synth.description: Waveform of oscillator 2.

synth.name: Osc2 Pulse Width
synth.description: Duty cycle of oscillator 2 when its waveform is Pulse (0.5 = square).

synth.name: Osc2 Level
synth.description: Mix level of oscillator 2.

synth.name: Osc2 Transpose
synth.description: Coarse pitch offset of oscillator 2 in cents (tuning independent; 1200 = one octave up).

synth.name: Osc2 Detune
synth.description: Fine detune of oscillator 2 against oscillator 1.

synth.name: Sub Osc Level
synth.description: Square wave one octave below oscillator 1.

synth.name: Noise Level
synth.description: White noise mixed into the filter input.

synth.name: Osc2 Hard Sync
synth.description: Restart oscillator 2 every cycle of oscillator 1 (classic sync lead; sweep Osc2 Transpose or Osc2 Env Pitch).

synth.name: Osc2 Env Pitch
synth.description: How far the filter envelope bends oscillator 2 pitch (sync sweeps, FM brightness changes).

synth.name: FM Index
synth.description: Phase modulation of oscillator 1 by oscillator 2 (0 = off; use Sine waves for bells/e-pianos).

synth.name: Filter Mode
synth.description: Filter response type.

synth.name: Filter Cutoff
synth.description: Base cutoff frequency of the resonant filter.

synth.name: Filter Resonance
synth.description: Filter resonance (approaches self-oscillation near 1).

synth.name: Filter Slope
synth.description: Filter slope: 2-pole or 4-pole.

synth.name: Filter Drive
synth.description: Soft saturation before the filter.

synth.name: Filter Env Amount
synth.description: How far the filter envelope moves the cutoff, in octaves.

synth.name: Filter Key Tracking
synth.description: Cutoff follows note frequency (1 = fully).

synth.name: Filter Velocity Amount
synth.description: How much note velocity scales the filter envelope.

synth.name: Filter Env Attack
synth.description: Filter envelope attack time.

synth.name: Filter Env Decay
synth.description: Filter envelope decay time.

synth.name: Filter Env Sustain
synth.description: Filter envelope sustain level.

synth.name: Filter Env Release
synth.description: Filter envelope release time.

synth.name: Amp Attack
synth.description: Amplitude envelope attack time.

synth.name: Amp Decay
synth.description: Amplitude envelope decay time.

synth.name: Amp Sustain
synth.description: Amplitude envelope sustain level.

synth.name: Amp Release
synth.description: Amplitude envelope release time.

synth.name: Amp Velocity Amount
synth.description: How much note velocity scales loudness (0 = ignore velocity).

synth.name: LFO Waveform
synth.description: Shape of the global LFO.

synth.name: LFO Rate
synth.description: Rate of the global LFO.

synth.name: LFO Pitch Depth
synth.description: Constant vibrato depth (independent of the mod wheel).

synth.name: LFO Filter Depth
synth.description: Constant filter cutoff modulation depth.

synth.name: LFO Pulse Width Depth
synth.description: Pulse width modulation (PWM) depth for Pulse waveforms.

synth.name: LFO Tremolo Depth
synth.description: Amplitude modulation (tremolo) depth.

synth.name: Mod Wheel Vibrato Depth
synth.description: Extra vibrato depth at full mod wheel.

synth.name: Mod Wheel Filter LFO Depth
synth.description: Extra filter cutoff wobble depth at full mod wheel.

synth.name: Pitch Bend Range
synth.description: Pitch bend range in cents (tuning independent; 200 = +/-2 semitones).

synth.name: Max Voices
synth.description: Maximum polyphony (1 = mono).

synth.name: Glide Time
synth.description: Portamento time from the previously played note (0 = off).

synth.name: Unison Voices
synth.description: Stacked detuned copies of both oscillators per note (supersaw-style thickness).

synth.name: Unison Detune
synth.description: Total detune spread across the unison copies.

synth.name: Unison Stereo Width
synth.description: How far the unison copies are spread left/right.

synth.name: Master Volume
synth.description: Output volume of the synth.

phys.name: Tuning Divisions Per Period
phys.description: Equal divisions of the period (12 = standard 12-TET, 19/22/31/53 etc. for microtonal EDOs). Ignored while a custom scale table is loaded.

phys.name: Tuning Period
phys.description: Size of the repeating period. 1200 = octave, 1901.955 = tritave (Bohlen-Pierce).

phys.name: Tuning Reference Note
phys.description: MIDI note number that sounds at the reference frequency.

phys.name: Tuning Reference Frequency
phys.description: Frequency of the reference note.

phys.name: Physical Model
phys.description: String: plucked delay-line loop. Modal: tuned resonators struck by a mallet. Bowed: delay lines + bow friction. Wind: bore + reed/jet. Mesh: 2D wave equation on a grid. Stiff string: string with dispersion (inharmonic partials).

phys.name: String Excitation
phys.description: What initially fills the delay line: a burst of noise (plucked) or a smooth pulse (hammered).

phys.name: String Decay
phys.description: Time for the fundamental to fall by 60 dB while the key is held (loop gain per round trip).

phys.name: String Damping
phys.description: Low-pass in the loop: higher = high harmonics die out faster (nylon/felt-like).

phys.name: String Pick Position
phys.description: Where the string is plucked (0.5 = middle, removes even harmonics; near 0 = bright/thin).

phys.name: String Pick Brightness
phys.description: Spectrum of the excitation (soft finger vs hard pick).

phys.name: Modal Material
phys.description: Set of mode frequency ratios / gains (measured or textbook values for each object).

phys.name: Modal Decay
phys.description: Decay time (-60 dB) of the lowest mode.

phys.name: Modal High Mode Damping
phys.description: How much faster higher modes decay than the fundamental.

phys.name: Modal Mallet Hardness
phys.description: Short hard mallet (1) excites high modes; long soft mallet (0) mostly the low ones.

phys.name: Modal Strike Position
phys.description: Where the object is struck; modes with a node there are not excited (approximation: sin(pi*k*pos)).

phys.name: Modal Ratio Stretch
phys.description: Bends the mode ratios toward (negative) or away from (positive) harmonic, to hear what inharmonicity does.

phys.name: Bow Pressure
phys.description: Force of the bow on the string: low = airy/flautando, high = gritty (steeper friction curve).

phys.name: Bow Speed
phys.description: Bow velocity (loudness and brightness of the Helmholtz motion).

phys.name: Bow Position
phys.description: Distance of the bow from the bridge (small = sul ponticello, larger = sul tasto).

phys.name: Bow Attack
phys.description: Time for the bow to reach full speed.

phys.name: Bowed String Brightness
phys.description: Losses of high frequencies at the bridge (string material / damping).

phys.name: Wind Type
phys.description: Reed: a pressure-controlled valve at a closed bore end (odd harmonics). Jet: an air jet across an open bore.

phys.name: Breath Pressure
phys.description: Blowing pressure; too low does not start the tone, too high overblows.

phys.name: Breath Noise
phys.description: Turbulence noise mixed into the breath.

phys.name: Breath Attack
phys.description: Time for the breath pressure to build up.

phys.name: Embouchure
phys.description: Reed stiffness (clarinet) or jet length (flute); changes the response and the overblowing point.

phys.name: Mesh Shape
phys.description: Shape of the vibrating 2D surface (fixed edges).

phys.name: Mesh Resolution
phys.description: Grid points per side (more = more modes and a smoother sound, but more CPU). Max 3 voices in this model.

phys.name: Mesh Decay
phys.description: Overall decay time of the surface.

phys.name: Mesh High Damping
phys.description: Extra damping of short wavelengths (high modes die faster, like a skin).

phys.name: Mesh Strike X
phys.description: Horizontal strike position (0.5 = centre).

phys.name: Mesh Strike Y
phys.description: Vertical strike position (0.5 = centre). Hitting the centre excites mostly the symmetric modes.

phys.name: Mesh Mallet Hardness
phys.description: Small hard mallet (1) vs broad soft mallet (0).

phys.name: Piano Inharmonicity
phys.description: String stiffness: higher partials are pushed sharp (dispersion all-pass filters in the loop).

phys.name: Piano Hammer Hardness
phys.description: Felt hardness: harder (and louder notes) excite more high partials.

phys.name: Piano Strike Position
phys.description: Where the hammer hits (about 1/8 on real pianos).

phys.name: Piano Decay
phys.description: Decay time of the fundamental while the key is held.

phys.name: Piano Damping
phys.description: Extra loss of high partials per round trip.

phys.name: Piano Unison Detune
phys.description: Two strings per note slightly detuned: slow beating and a two-stage decay.

phys.name: Vibrato Depth
phys.description: Pitch vibrato for the delay-line models (string, bowed, wind, stiff string).

phys.name: Vibrato Rate
phys.description: Vibrato speed.

phys.name: Release Damping
phys.description: Decay time after the key is released (like a damper touching the string/bar).

phys.name: Velocity Amount
phys.description: How much velocity changes loudness and brightness.

phys.name: Stereo Width
phys.description: Spreads low notes left and high notes right.

phys.name: Pitch Bend Range
phys.description: Pitch bend range in cents.

phys.name: Volume
phys.description: Output volume of the physical model instrument.

drums.name: Kick Pitch
drums.description: Final (resting) frequency of the kick sine.

drums.name: Kick Decay
drums.description: Amplitude decay time of the kick (to -60 dB).

drums.name: Kick Tone
drums.description: Click transient and saturation amount.

drums.name: Kick Level
drums.description: Output level of the kick.

drums.name: Kick Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the kick (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Kick Pitch Sweep Depth
drums.description: How many octaves above the resting pitch the kick starts.

drums.name: Kick Pitch Sweep Time
drums.description: Time constant of the downward pitch sweep.

drums.name: Snare Pitch
drums.description: Frequency of the tonal (drum shell) component.

drums.name: Snare Decay
drums.description: Decay time of the noise (snares) component.

drums.name: Snare Tone
drums.description: Brightness of the band-passed noise (low = dark, high = bright).

drums.name: Snare Level
drums.description: Output level of the snare.

drums.name: Snare Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the snare (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Snare Snappy
drums.description: Balance between tonal body (0) and noise (1).

drums.name: Clap Pitch
drums.description: Center frequency of the band-pass filter on the noise.

drums.name: Clap Decay
drums.description: Decay time of the reverberant tail after the bursts.

drums.name: Clap Tone
drums.description: Filter sharpness (low = wide/noisy, high = narrow/ringing).

drums.name: Clap Level
drums.description: Output level of the clap.

drums.name: Clap Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the clap (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Clap Burst Spread
drums.description: Gap between the individual hand-clap bursts.

drums.name: Closed Hi-Hat Pitch
drums.description: Base frequency of the metallic square-wave cluster.

drums.name: Closed Hi-Hat Decay
drums.description: Decay time of the closed hi-hat.

drums.name: Closed Hi-Hat Tone
drums.description: High-pass cutoff (brightness).

drums.name: Closed Hi-Hat Level
drums.description: Output level of the closed hi-hat.

drums.name: Closed Hi-Hat Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the closed hi-hat (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Closed Hi-Hat Metal Mix
drums.description: Balance between noise (0) and detuned square cluster (1).

drums.name: Open Hi-Hat Pitch
drums.description: Base frequency of the metallic square-wave cluster.

drums.name: Open Hi-Hat Decay
drums.description: Decay time of the open hi-hat (closed hi-hat chokes it).

drums.name: Open Hi-Hat Tone
drums.description: High-pass cutoff (brightness).

drums.name: Open Hi-Hat Level
drums.description: Output level of the open hi-hat.

drums.name: Open Hi-Hat Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the open hi-hat (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Open Hi-Hat Metal Mix
drums.description: Balance between noise (0) and detuned square cluster (1).

drums.name: Low Tom Decay

drums.name: Low Tom Level

drums.name: Low Tom Pan

drums.name: Mid Tom Pitch

drums.name: Mid Tom Decay
drums.description: Amplitude decay time of the tom.

drums.name: Mid Tom Tone
drums.description: Downward pitch bend at the attack plus stick noise.

drums.name: Mid Tom Level
drums.description: Output level of the mid tom.

drums.name: Mid Tom Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the mid tom (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: High Tom Decay

drums.name: High Tom Tone

drums.name: Rimshot Decay

drums.name: Rimshot Tone

drums.name: Cowbell Decay

drums.name: Cowbell Level

drums.name: Ride Decay
